title: US Market Week Ahead: Nvidia Earnings, Retail Sales
summary: Nvidia's first report without Jensen Huang, October retail sales, FOMC minutes and Anthropic's IPO shape US stocks this week.
body_markdown:
The FOMC minutes will also be read closely. Investors want to gauge how much support exists inside the Fed for a rate hike at the December meeting.


## This Week's Earnings Calendar


The third-quarter earnings season is nearly done, but a few large reports remain. According to FactSet as of November 6, 2026, the blended earnings growth rate for the S&P 500 in Q3 stands at 31.4%.


If that holds, it would mark the third straight quarter of earnings growth above 25%. That sets a high bar for the companies still to report.


Here is when some of the week's larger companies report, with consensus EPS estimates from Zacks:


- **[Home Depot (HD)](https://www.heygotrade.com/en/us-stock/hd/) :** Tuesday, Nov 17, before the open, consensus EPS US$3.87. The market will read demand for home improvement while rates stay high.
- **[Nvidia (NVDA)](https://www.heygotrade.com/en/us-stock/nvda/) :** Tuesday, Nov 17, after the close, consensus EPS US$2.49. Focus is on data center revenue growth and guidance from the new leadership team.
- **[TJX (TJX)](https://www.heygotrade.com/en/us-stock/tjx/) :** Wednesday, Nov 18, before the open, consensus EPS US$1.33. The report offers a read on spending in off-price retail.
- **[Walmart (WMT)](https://www.heygotrade.com/en/us-stock/wmt/) :** Thursday, Nov 19, before the open, consensus EPS US$0.64. The market will look at US comparable sales and the holiday season outlook.


Other reports scheduled this week:


- **Monday, Nov 16:**[Baidu (BIDU)](https://www.heygotrade.com/en/us-stock/bidu/) before the open.
- **Tuesday, Nov 17:**[Disney (DIS)](https://www.heygotrade.com/en/us-stock/dis/) before the open.
- **Wednesday, Nov 18:**[Lowe's (LOW)](https://www.heygotrade.com/en/us-stock/low/) and[Target (TGT)](https://www.heygotrade.com/en/us-stock/tgt/) before the open, then[Palo Alto Networks (PANW)](https://www.heygotrade.com/en/us-stock/panw/) after the close.
- **Thursday, Nov 19:**[Intuit (INTU)](https://www.heygotrade.com/en/us-stock/intu/) and[Ross Stores (ROST)](https://www.heygotrade.com/en/us-stock/rost/) after the close.


Nvidia's report carries extra weight this time. Jensen Huang resigned as CEO on Thursday, November 12, and CFO Colette Kress now serves as interim CEO.


Investors will watch whether the leadership change affects Nvidia's business outlook. The results could also move the wider semiconductor and AI sectors.


## Market Sentiment


The main market narrative is a tug-of-war between strong corporate earnings and the risk of higher rates. According to FXEmpire, October inflation data raised expectations for a Fed rate hike in December.


Investors are also still questioning the cost of building data centers and the returns on that AI investment. That is why Nvidia's results are seen as a test for the AI trade as a whole.


A second test comes from Anthropic, the developer of the Claude AI models, which plans to go public. According to FXEmpire, Anthropic shares are expected to begin trading on Thursday, November 19.


How the market receives the listing could show how strong investor appetite for AI companies is right now. An offering of this size may also draw liquidity away from other tech names in the short term.


On the consumer side, the retail reports will show whether higher energy prices and borrowing costs are starting to weigh on US household spending. That matters because consumption is the main engine of the US economy.


For readers outside the US, timing matters too. Most of these releases land during evening or overnight hours in Southeast Asia, so price moves often happen while local markets are closed.


With an agenda this packed, volatility could rise through the week. We see overall sentiment as neutral: last week's rally gives momentum, but rate risk and uncertainty at Nvidia still hang over the market.
